chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Bashīr, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan — may Allah be pleased with him — from al-Ḥasan ibn Mattayl al-Daqqāq, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Bashīr al-Kūfī.

key_terms.جَعْفَرِ ابْنِ بَشِيرٍ: A transmitter in the chain linking the author to ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Bashīr.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; a transmission verb indicating the author’s route of report.
key_terms.عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ الْكُوفِيّ: A Kūfan narrator whose transmission route is being identified here.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ: An early transmitter in the author’s sanad/isnad for this report.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Bashīr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Bashīr al-Kūfī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and clarifying the author’s route to this narrator.
